property_summary: After setL1BlockValues, the stored hash must exactly equal the _hash parameter; the buggy version stores keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_hash)) instead, violating equality for inputs where _hash != keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_hash)).
change_summary: Replace the right-hand side of the hash assignment with a different parameter, e.g. keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_hash)).
